traits.text: {=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Gondor_Regions}A new region answers the call every 30 seconds. Pay to call one by name.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Gondor_Walls}Towers have 40% more hit points.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Gondor_Core}Only militia are always at hand.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Rohan_Riders}The finest cavalry in Middle-earth.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Rohan_Sentries}Sentries keep watch: your towers fire 30% faster.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Rohan_Charge}Riders deal about a third of the damage to towers.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Rohan_Foot}Weak foot soldiers and archers.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Mordor_Horde}100 more troops in the field, and free waves come a quarter sooner.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Mordor_Beasts}Call a creature to battle every 30 seconds.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Mordor_Orcs}Orcs are very weak. Uruks and Numenoreans cost a lot.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Isengard_Siege}Your units deal 15% more damage to towers.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Isengard_Waves}Free waves grow stronger every 5 minutes.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Isengard_Few}50 fewer troops in the field, and only warg riders for cavalry.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Elves_FarSight}Far Sight: elven towers fire 50% further than any others.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Rivendell_Heroes}All three heroes may fight at once.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Elves_Few}Only 150 troops in the field, and only five kinds.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Rivendell_SlowWaves}Free troops come at half the usual rate.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Erebor_Gold}Mountain Gold: 40% more income.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Erebor_Stonewrights}Stonewrights: your towers mend 4 times as fast.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Erebor_Slow}Free waves come a quarter later, with few bows and no horses.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Harad_Beasts}Call a war elephant or a mûmak every 2 minutes.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Harad_Poison}Poisoned arrows: a struck soldier loses 3 hit points a second for 8 seconds, through any armour.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Harad_Towers}Towers have 15% fewer hit points.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Harad_Cost}A fallen beast is a heavy loss of gold.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Gundabad_Waves}Free waves come twice as often.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Gundabad_Cheap}Packs cost a quarter less.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Gundabad_Fade}Free waves never improve, and towers have 30% fewer hit points.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Dale_Arrows}Black Arrows: your archers deal 4 times the damage to towers.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Dale_Bows}Four kinds of archers on offer.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Dale_Melee}Weak foot soldiers, and few riders.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_DolGuldur_Shadow}The Shadow: enemy towers fire a quarter slower.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_DolGuldur_FellWargs}Call a fell warg every 45 seconds.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_DolGuldur_Venom}Venomed arrows: a struck soldier loses 2 hit points a second for 6 seconds, through any armour.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_DolGuldur_FewStrong}Its strongest soldiers come only in small packs of three.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Easterlings_Discipline}Discipline: new orders are ready twice as fast.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Easterlings_Army}Horse archers and iron legions in one army.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Easterlings_Towers}Towers fire 15% slower.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Umbar_Plunder}Plunder: camps pay 3 times as much and capture points twice as much.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Umbar_Bounty}Kills pay a quarter more.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Umbar_Poor}20% less income, and no troop above the middle ranks.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Elves_FarSight}Far Sight: elven towers fire 50% further than any others.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Mirkwood_Archers}The finest archers in Middle-earth.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Elves_Few}Only 150 troops in the field, and only five kinds.
{=TAOM_FOW_Trait_Mirkwood_SlowWaves}Free troops come a third less often.
